system.description: This exceptionally crafted katana is far heavier than the average blade of its type, bringing far more force to bear on its razor edge blade. A Dotanuki is known to cut foes in two.

extraordinaryProperties.name: special
extraordinaryProperties.value: A devastating blow from the Dotanuki can cause a target to bleed out rapidly. Any time the Dotanuki's attack exceeds the target's defense by 20 or more, the persistent damage 9 bane is automatically applied to the target.
